clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers the requirements of wooden sleepers  and wooden  specials used  for  broad gauge ,metre and narrow gauge  railway  tracks.

clauses.title: Timber Species
clauses.text: 2. Timber Species —  See Appendix A of the standard for recommended species and their composite sleeper Index (CSI).

clauses.title: Special Sleepers for Bridges and Crossings
clauses.text: 3.2 Special Sleepers for Bridges and Crossings — See Table 2

clauses.title: Preservative Treatment
clauses.text: 4. Preservative Treatment —  Sleepers containing sap wood and those without an asterisk mark in Appendix A shall be given preservative treatment.

clauses.title: Grading
clauses.text: 5. Grading —  Class I and Class II, depending on permissible defects. A sleeper shall be classified as of the Class II even if it is of that class in terms of only one defect and is of the Class I in terms of all other defects. Likewise, a sleeper shall be rejected if the permissible range in any one of the defects is exceeded. Special sleepers shall be of Class I only.

clauses.title: Permissible Defects
clauses.text: 6. Permissible Defects — Refer Table 4 of the standard.
